pages.text:
Public Review and Comment 
The Draft EIR is available on the Project webpage for a 61‐day public review and comment period from April 1 
through May 31, 2025. For reference, the draft LRDP and related information is also available from the 
Project webpage. A paper copy of the Draft EIR is available for review at the Berkeley Main Public Library 
reference desk: 2090 Kittredge Street in Berkeley. 
During the Draft EIR public comment period, agencies and the public may submit comments on the content 
and adequacy of the Draft EIR analysis. Comments may be submitted in writing and/or orally at the Draft 
EIR public hearing (see information below). 
Written Comment Submission 
Submission of written comments via e-mail is encouraged.  Please e-mail comments to Planning@lbl.gov. 
Should you wish to send written comments via regular mail, please mail your comment letter to Jeff Philliber, 
LBNL, 1 Cyclotron Road, M/S 50A-4112, Berkeley, CA 94720. Please include your full name and address in 
written correspondence. To be considered and addressed in the 2025 LRDP Final EIR, comments must be 
received no later than 5:00 PM on May 31, 2025. 
Oral Comment Submission: Draft EIR Public Hearing 
Berkeley Lab will hold a Draft EIR Public Hearing on May 13, 2025 beginning at 5:00 PM to receive oral 
comments on the adequacy of the information presented in the Draft EIR.  The Draft EIR Public Hearing will 
be a virtual meeting conducted via Zoom.  If you are interested in attending this meeting, you must register in 
advance.  After registering, you will receive a confirmation e-mail containing information about joining the 
meeting. 
Please note that all public comments made in writing or in oral testimony at the Draft EIR Public Hearing will 
be part of the public record. Comments received at the Public Hearing or in writing during the comment 
period will be responded to in a Comments and Responses document prepared in conjunction with the Final 
EIR. After their review of the Final EIR, including the Comments and Responses document, the Regents of 
the University of California will be asked to consider certification of the Final EIR along with adoption of the 
2025 LRDP. 
Thank you for your interest in this project. 
Jeff Philliber, Senior Site & Environmental Planner 
Strategic Infrastructure Planning Office 
Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory  
1 Cyclotron Road, M/S 50A-4112 
Berkeley, CA 94720 
(510) 499-4012 
Planning@lbl.gov
